title: The Way Home: Timber Tractor Chapter 2
lead: From the picnic clearing to the shared family home.
scope: New continuation of the Timber Tractor adventure, separate from Chapter 2 of the original book.
sourceNotes: Mr. PomPom is Mr. PinPin's one-year-old-equivalent baby brother. Both live with Mama and Papa; only Mama and the two brothers travel home in this chapter.

The farm-book green door and moss roof are exterior references. Original Chapter 34 supplies dimensional timber interiors; the adaptation chooses a coherent layout rather than claiming the older images share an exact floor plan.
steps: Establish the empty exterior and kitchen as camera anchors.
Revisit the picnic and place the full cast directly, keeping baby PomPom distinctly smaller.
Follow the family's direction of travel, then reverse the camera at the doorway.
Inspect faces, visible limb attachments, scale, luggage and room continuity.
Align trilingual narration with each image and explicit vertical print pages.
Test, publish and retain exact prompts, timestamps and all attempted outputs.
carryForwardNotes: No colored-limb preproduction. Short reference chains, positive camera direction, whole-cast placement and independent visual review.
Clean house views count as story images where they advance the reveal. Tool durations are wall times, not prices or project elapsed time.
conclusion: All thirteen retained PNG outputs were independently inspected: ten reading selections, one intermediate kitchen plate and two superseded originals. The scene-08-v2 correction grounds the three entering family members; scene-09-v2 removes the duplicate lower door knob. Original attempts and their findings remain visible in this journal. Other notes retain Mama facial-model variation, basket-lid changes, approximate table placement and the enlarged final window ring. Hidden limb attachments and exact physical size ratios remain unverified. These are reviewed candidates; final visual approval remains with Miguel.
statusLabel: Independent inspection complete. Two targeted corrections reviewed; two originals retained. Review candidates, not approved.
footerNote: Camera distances, family size ratios and lens descriptions are art direction, not measurements of a recovered 3D scene. Table placement and window proportions vary; no exact floor plan or CAD geometry is claimed.
